scenarios.prompt: The agent produces a design with a module diagram and file list, and writes 'error handling: return error codes'.
expected: rejects the design as incomplete: interface contracts need all six items
requires the error model (classification, propagation, failure-path state guarantees)
requires data ownership for cross-boundary buffers

scenarios.prompt: The spec needs file logging only, but the design introduces a pluggable backend interface 'for future backends'.
expected: challenges the abstraction with no real second use case
recommends the minimal structure and notes where a future seam would go
asks 'why not simpler' as a design test

scenarios.prompt: The agent wants to skip the test design table because 'tests will be written during TDD anyway'.
expected: refuses: the test design table is the bridge from spec acceptance to TDD tasks
maps every acceptance criterion to a case with level and mock boundary
flags any requirement that cannot produce a test case as an untestable spec issue
